name: ARK: Survival Evolved
description: ARK: Survival Evolved dedicated server. The game port is UDP and is 7777 by convention; ARK also opens the game port + 1, so give the Raw UDP port that number. The console is an RCON session and becomes available once the map has loaded, which takes several minutes. Stopping saves the world first.
startup_command: ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD="${ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-$(head -c 16 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')}"; arkrcon() { rcon -t rcon -a "127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}}" -p "${ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD}" "$@"; }; stop_ark() { echo "[Atlas] Saving the world and stopping ARK..."; arkrcon SaveWorld && arkrcon DoExit || kill "${ARK_PID}" 2>/dev/null; wait "${ARK_PID}"; echo "[Atlas] Server closed."; exit 0; }; trap stop_ark INT TERM;  ( cd ShooterGame/Binaries/Linux && exec ./ShooterGameServer "${SERVER_MAP}?listen?SessionName=${SESSION_NAME}?ServerPassword=${ARK_PASSWORD}?ServerAdminPassword=${ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD}?Port={{SERVER_PORT}}?QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}}?RCONPort={{RCON_PORT}}?RCONEnabled=True?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}?GameModIds=${MOD_ID}" -server -automanagedmods -log $( [[ "${BATTLE_EYE}" =~ ^(1|true)$ ]] || printf %s -NoBattlEye ) ${ARGS} ) & ARK_PID=$!;  until echo "[Atlas] Waiting for the RCON connection..."; ( arkrcon ) <&0 & wait $!; do kill -0 "${ARK_PID}" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 5; done; wait "${ARK_PID}"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server list. It cannot contain a question mark.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map to load: TheIsland, TheCenter, ScorchedEarth_P, Ragnarok, Aberration_P, Extinction, Valguero_P, Genesis, CrystalIsles, Gen2, LostIsland or Fjordur.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for in-game admin commands (enablecheats) and for RCON. When empty, a random one is used for each run, so the console and a clean stop still work but nobody can log in as an admin.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Most players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Steam Workshop mod ids, separated by commas. The server downloads and updates them on start.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts. ARK is large, so the check adds a minute or more to every start.
